text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, I see
<chrname> back
to her dorm
after the day's training runs a little

longer than expected. Just after we say
our
goodbyes...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!

Nice to see you! Are you heading home
now?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I see! I just saw Meek off and was
thinking about
heading back to the
trainer dorms myself, so...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If it's all right with you, why don't we go
back
together?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Unless you think that's a little too—how
should I
put this—chummy? We are
coworkers, after all...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
choice_data_list: そんなことありません

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We talk about various things on the way
back to
the dorms.
